The only line of each test case contains three integers $$$n$$$, $$$k$$$, and $$$m$$$ ($$$1 \le k \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$, $$$1 \le m \le 10^9$$$).
It is guaranteed that the sum of $$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed $$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$.
